sourceTree: Uncommitted Phase 2 crop worktree based on this commit; measured after the final fixture, verifier, architecture-owner, and pre-registration staging-cleanup changes and before the coordinator-required independent diff audit.
sampleMethod: One generated release-build sample per case. Per-case totalMs excludes Rust compilation; commandElapsedMs includes it. workingSetDeltaBytes is the Windows process working-set sample after the completed operation minus the sample immediately before stage_crop, so it is process-memory evidence rather than a peak claim.
persistenceTimingScope: databaseMs spans the existing Phase 1 register_staged creating-row insert, staging promotion, canonical validation, and ready-state update.
concurrencyEvidence: The generated fixture samples are uncontended (queueWaitMs is 0). The deterministic barrier test clipping_crop_serializes_distinct_requests_with_one_active_crop_section dynamically proves the one-lane bound; the structural gate independently requires crop_permit and admission/recheck ordering.
uiStallEvidence: The command dispatches full native crop work through Tauri spawn_blocking; queueWaitMs is an uncontended single-lane baseline. Existing Newspaper performance and browser gates remain separate required regression evidence.
